notes: Tuition: both programme pages state there are no tuition fees for this degree programme ('Tuition fees per semester None'; 'Fees: None (only semester fees)'). The semester contribution (approx. 380 EUR per semester on the DAAD page, 394.80 EUR for winter semester 2026/27 on the Semester Fee page) is not a tuition fee. Deadline: the applications page gives '15 May for non-EU and non-EEA applicants' and the programme page 'Application deadline: 15 May (non EU and non EEA applicants)'; no year is attached to this date, so it is given as a recurringDeadline. The '01 September' application opening and the 'WINTER SEMESTER 2027/28' header are for all applicants (all lines of the same sentence); the opening is given as 2026-09-01 by taking 01 September from the winter semester 2027/28 cycle, so the human auditor should verify the cycle. Application channel: the DAAD page says the university does not cooperate with uni-assist, so for this programme foreign-diploma applicants apply directly (university's own route); note that a different programme (International Business) at the main campus requires uni-assist, and the Application Portal page mentions 'Uni-Assist Application' for German higher education entrance qualification holders. Teaching language: modules are taught in English with integrated German/foreign-language modules, so only 'en' is listed. A 'Fact Sheet' and 'Application Form' PDFs are offered as downloads but no explicit document list for international applicants of this programme is given on the pages, so no documents fact is stated; the DAAD page says English B2 must be proven with an official language certificate.
